results.name: Home Screen Loading
results.expected: HomeScene is active with canvas, character, parallax environment, and play button

results.name: Settings Opening / Closing
results.expected: Settings modal opens (visible=true) and closes smoothly after animation (visible=false)

results.name: Music Volume Adjustment
results.expected: Music volume gain adjusts smoothly and persists via SaveManager & AudioManager

results.name: SFX Volume Adjustment
results.expected: SFX volume gain adjusts accurately and persists via SaveManager & AudioManager

results.name: Vibration Preference
results.expected: Haptic vibration preference toggles and persists cleanly
results.actual: Toggled successfully: true, AudioManager sync: true

results.name: Reduced-Motion Preference
results.expected: Reduced-motion toggle persists and updates EnvironmentManager parallax dampening
results.actual: Environment dampening active: true, Save persisted: true

results.name: Tutorial Navigation
results.expected: TutorialScene opens with animated step cards and back navigation

results.name: Campaign World Selection
results.expected: WorldSelectScene is active displaying 3 distinct campaign world cards

results.name: Level Selection Grid
results.expected: LevelSelectScene displays 10 level nodes for World 1 with star ratings & unlock states

results.name: Candy Dragging
results.expected: Candy position responds to input drag with slingshot offset and squash

results.name: Trajectory Preview
results.expected: Trajectory dotted arc renders with ballistic math, collision lock, and gravity curve
results.actual: Points rendered: 26, Target lock detected: true

results.name: Candy Throwing
results.expected: Candy launches with upward ballistic velocity, rotation torque, and active flight state

results.name: Normal Catch
results.expected: Score increases by 10 points base, combo increments, character plays chew animation
results.actual: Awarded: +10 pts, Combo incremented: true, Chew: true

results.name: Perfect Catch
results.expected: Perfect bullseye center catch awards 15+ points with sparkle particles and perfect float

results.name: Miss Behavior
results.expected: Miss deducts 1 life, resets combo multiplier to 0, and plays miss reaction

results.name: Combo Multiplier Progression
results.expected: Combo builds from 1x to 2x (at 3 hits) and 3x (at 5 hits)

results.name: Power-Up Activation
results.expected: Power-ups (Magnet, SlowMo 0.55x, Multiplier 2x, Shield) activate and configure runtime hooks
results.actual: Magnet: true, SlowMo scale: 0.55, Mult: true, Shield: true

results.name: Pause System
results.expected: Pause freezes game physics, locks inputs, and displays pause overlay

results.name: Resume System
results.expected: Resume unfreezes gameplay, hides pause overlay, and restores input handling

results.name: Restart Lifecycle
results.expected: Restart resets score to 0, lives to 3, combo to 0, and respawns candy
results.actual: Lives: true, Score: true, Combo: true

results.name: Level Completion Victory Modal
results.expected: Victory modal opens with earned stars, coins reward, and next level CTA
results.actual: Visible: true, Header: "LEVEL COMPLETE!", HasNextBtn: true

results.name: Game Over Lifecycle
results.expected: Depleting all lives transitions cleanly to GameOverScene with stats and retry button

results.name: Score Persistence
results.expected: High score updates and persists into save storage schema

results.name: Save Persistence After Reload
results.expected: Browser reload rehydrates persisted coins and high scores without data degradation

results.name: Shop & Wardrobe Regression
results.expected: ShopScene renders Power-Ups and Wardrobe tabs with unlockable cosmetics
results.actual: Active: true, Powerups Tab: true, Wardrobe Tab: true

results.name: Daily Missions Regression
results.expected: MissionScene displays active daily quests with progress tracking and claim rewards

results.name: Achievements Regression
results.expected: Achievements tab displays all 9 progression badges with real-time unlock status

results.name: Coin Economy Regression
results.expected: EconomyManager accurately validates balance, processes purchases, and blocks overspending

results.name: Mobile Touch Interaction
results.expected: Canvas supports native mobile touch gestures, multi-touch input, and interactive candy dragging

results.name: Responsive Layout (6 Viewports)
results.expected: Phaser canvas auto-scales and centers cleanly across all 6 mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
results.actual: All 6 viewports tested and verified (allPassed: true)
